name: Ericsson Xperia X10 Mini

images.credit: Havarhen, CC BY-SA 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.Technology: 2G, Quad-band GSM/GPRS Class 10 (4+1/3+2 slots), 32–48 kbit/s/EDGE: 850/900/1800/1900 MHz, 3G, Tri-band UMTS/HSDPA/HSUPA: 850/1900/2100/900 MHz

Memory.Storage: 128 MB in phone, up to 64 GB on microSDHC memory card (2 GB card included)

Display.Display: TFT, 2.55 in, 16M color, 240×320 pixels (157 ppi) (QVGA), hardened

Cameras.Rear camera: 5 MP with Auto focus, Flash LED illumination and Geo tagging.

Connectivity.Connectivity: GPS, Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g, Bluetooth 2.0 with A2DP, microUSB 2.0, 3.5 mm audio jack
